name: x2611_15210_thm1_3
original:
Let $\alpha_{*}>2$ be the root of $\alpha_{*}^{5}=12\alpha_{*}+8\sqrt[3]{3}$ , so
 $\alpha_{*}=2.0491202034\ldots$ . Then, for every $r\geq 1$ ,

 $\mathsf{s}(C_{6}^{r})\ \geq\ c\,\alpha_{*}^{r}+1,\qquad c=2\cdot 3^{-5/3}\Bigl(\frac{2}{\alpha_{*}}\Bigr)^{4}.$

sketches.body:
lemma x2611_15210_thm1_3_aux1 (β a : ℝ) (hβ : 1 < β) (ha : 0 < a)
    (heq : a ^ 5 = 12 * a + 8 * β) : 2 < a := by
  by_contra hgt
  have hle : a ≤ 2 := le_of_not_gt hgt
  have hpow : a ^ 4 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_left₀ ha.le hle 4
  have hpow5 : a ^ 5 ≤ 16 * a := by
    calc
      a ^ 5 = a ^ 4 * a := by ring
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ 4 * a := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow ha.le
      _ = 16 * a := by norm_num
  linarith

lemma x2611_15210_thm1_3_aux2 (β : ℝ) (hβ : 1 < β) (hβupper : β ≤ 3) :
    2 < x2611_15210_alpha β ∧
      (x2611_15210_alpha β) ^ 5 = 12 * x2611_15210_alpha β + 8 * β := by
  have hnonempty : {a : ℝ | 0 < a ∧ a ^ 5 = 12 * a + 8 * β}.Nonempty := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun a : ℝ => a ^ 5 - 12 * a - 8 * β) := by fun_prop
    have hlo : (2 : ℝ) ^ 5 - 12 * 2 - 8 * β ≤ 0 := by linarith
    have hhi : 0 ≤ (3 : ℝ) ^ 5 - 12 * 3 - 8 * β := by linarith
    obtain ⟨a, ha, heq⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 3)
      hc.continuousOn (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ 5 - 12 * 2 - 8 * β)
        ((3 : ℝ) ^ 5 - 12 * 3 - 8 * β) from ⟨hlo, hhi⟩)
    exact ⟨a, by linarith [ha.1], by linarith⟩
  have hset : {a : ℝ | 0 < a ∧ a ^ 5 = 12 * a + 8 * β} =
      {a : ℝ | 2 ≤ a ∧ a ^ 5 = 12 * a + 8 * β} := by
    ext a
    constructor
    · intro ha
      exact ⟨(x2611_15210_thm1_3_aux1 β a hβ ha.1 ha.2).le, ha.2⟩
    · intro ha
      exact ⟨by linarith [ha.1], ha.2⟩
  have hclosed : IsClosed {a : ℝ | 0 < a ∧ a ^ 5 = 12 * a + 8 * β} := by
    rw [hset]
    exact (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_id).inter
      (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop))
  have hmem : 0 < x2611_15210_alpha β ∧
      (x2611_15210_alpha β) ^ 5 = 12 * x2611_15210_alpha β + 8 * β :=
    hclosed.csInf_mem hnonempty ⟨0, fun a ha => ha.1.le⟩
  exact ⟨x2611_15210_thm1_3_aux1 β _ hβ hmem.1 hmem.2, hmem.2⟩

lemma x2611_15210_thm1_3_aux3 (a : ℝ) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ 4) :
    (2 / a) ^ 4 * a ^ r ≤ 2 ^ r := by
  have ha0 : 0 < a := by linarith
  have hp : (2 : ℝ) ^ (4 - r) ≤ a ^ (4 - r) :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) ha _
  have he : r + (4 - r) = 4 := by omega
  have hmain : (2 : ℝ) ^ 4 * a ^ r ≤ 2 ^ r * a ^ 4 := by
    calc
      (2 : ℝ) ^ 4 * a ^ r = (2 ^ r * a ^ r) * 2 ^ (4 - r) := by
        calc
          (2 : ℝ) ^ 4 * a ^ r = (2 ^ r * 2 ^ (4 - r)) * a ^ r := by
            rw [← pow_add, he]
          _ = (2 ^ r * a ^ r) * 2 ^ (4 - r) := by ring
      _ ≤ (2 ^ r * a ^ r) * a ^ (4 - r) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (by positivity)
      _ = 2 ^ r * a ^ 4 := by
        calc
          _ = 2 ^ r * (a ^ r * a ^ (4 - r)) := by ring
          _ = 2 ^ r * a ^ 4 := by rw [← pow_add, he]
  rw [div_pow]
  calc
    (2 : ℝ) ^ 4 / a ^ 4 * a ^ r = (2 ^ 4 * a ^ r) / a ^ 4 := by ring
    _ ≤ 2 ^ r := (div_le_iff₀ (pow_pos ha0 4)).2 hmain

lemma x2611_15210_thm1_3_aux4 (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (c a β : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (heq : a ^ 5 = 12 * a + 8 * β)
    (hinit : ∀ r s : ℕ, c * 2 ^ r * β ^ s ≤ f r s)
    (hstep : ∀ r s : ℕ, 12 * f (r + 1) s + 8 * f r (s + 1) ≤ f (r + 5) s) :
    ∀ r s : ℕ, c * (2 / a) ^ 4 * a ^ r * β ^ s ≤ f r s := by
  intro r
  induction r using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h r ih =>
    intro s
    by_cases hr : r < 5
    · calc
        c * (2 / a) ^ 4 * a ^ r * β ^ s = c * ((2 / a) ^ 4 * a ^ r) * β ^ s := by ring
        _ ≤ c * 2 ^ r * β ^ s := by
          gcongr
          exact x2611_15210_thm1_3_aux3 a ha r (by omega)
        _ ≤ f r s := hinit r s
    · have hr5 : r - 5 + 5 = r := by omega
      have h1 := ih (r - 5 + 1) (by omega) s
      have h0 := ih (r - 5) (by omega) (s + 1)
      calc
        c * (2 / a) ^ 4 * a ^ r * β ^ s =
            12 * (c * (2 / a) ^ 4 * a ^ (r - 5 + 1) * β ^ s) +
              8 * (c * (2 / a) ^ 4 * a ^ (r - 5) * β ^ (s + 1)) := by
          conv_lhs => rw [← hr5, pow_add, heq]
          rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]
          ring
        _ ≤ 12 * f (r - 5 + 1) s + 8 * f (r - 5) (s + 1) := by linarith
        _ ≤ f r s := by simpa only [hr5] using hstep (r - 5) s

lemma x2611_15210_thm1_3_aux5 (L : ℕ) (G : Type*)
    [AddCommMonoid G] [Fintype G] (hL : 0 < L) (hz : ∀ g : G, L • g = 0) :
    L ≤ x2611_15210_s L G := by
  classical
  have hprop : ∀ a : Fin (Fintype.card G * (L - 1) + 1) → G,
      ∃ I : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card G * (L - 1) + 1)),
        I.card = L ∧ ∑ i ∈ I, a i = 0 := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Fintype.exists_lt_card_fiber_of_mul_lt_card a
      (show Fintype.card G * (L - 1) <
        Fintype.card (Fin (Fintype.card G * (L - 1) + 1)) by simp)
    obtain ⟨I, hI, hcard⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq (show L ≤
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => a i = g)).card by omega)
    refine ⟨I, hcard, ?_⟩
    calc
      ∑ i ∈ I, a i = ∑ _i ∈ I, g := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hI hi)).2
      _ = L • g := by simp [hcard]
      _ = 0 := hz g
  have hs : ∀ a : Fin (x2611_15210_s L G) → G,
      ∃ I : Finset (Fin (x2611_15210_s L G)), I.card = L ∧ ∑ i ∈ I, a i = 0 :=
    Nat.sInf_mem (show Set.Nonempty {s : ℕ | ∀ a : Fin s → G,
      ∃ I : Finset (Fin s), I.card = L ∧ ∑ i ∈ I, a i = 0} from ⟨_, hprop⟩)
  obtain ⟨I, hI, _⟩ := hs (fun _ => 0)
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_univ I
  simpa only [hI, Fintype.card_fin] using hcard

theorem x2611_15210_thm1_3 : 2 < (x2611_15210_alpha ((3 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3))) ∧ (x2611_15210_alpha ((3 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3))) ^ 5 = 12 * (x2611_15210_alpha ((3 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3))) + 8 * (3 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) ∧ ∀ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r → (2 * (3 : ℝ) ^ (-(5 : ℝ) / 3) * (2 / (x2611_15210_alpha ((3 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)))) ^ 4) * (x2611_15210_alpha ((3 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3))) ^ r + 1 ≤ (x2611_15210_s (6) (Fin (r) → ZMod (6)) : ℝ) := by
  have H :
      (∀ b : ℝ, 0 < b → b ^ 3 = 3 → ∀ s : ℕ,
        (2 / b ^ 5) * b ^ s ≤ (x2611_15210_A 6 (Fin s → ZMod 3) : ℝ)) ∧
      (∃ f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ,
        (∀ r s : ℕ, 2 ^ r * (x2611_15210_A 6 (Fin s → ZMod 3) : ℝ) ≤ f r s) ∧
        (∀ r s : ℕ, 12 * f (r + 1) s + 8 * f r (s + 1) ≤ f (r + 5) s) ∧
        (∀ r : ℕ, f r 0 ≤ (x2611_15210_A 6 (Fin r → ZMod 6) : ℝ))) := by
    constructor
    · -- Lemma 5.1 gives 2 * 3^k at ranks 3*k for odd k; pad ranks,
      -- choosing 3*k between s-5 and s. Handle s < 3 by constant sequences.
      sorry
    · -- Choose f r s = A_6((C_6)^r × (C_3)^s).
      -- Binary fibers give the first bound; Theorem 3.1 gives the recurrence.
      -- The rank-zero C_3 factor is trivial, giving the final comparison.
      sorry
  obtain ⟨hbaseRoot, f, hinit, hstep, hfinal⟩ := H
  let β : ℝ := (3 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)
  let a : ℝ := x2611_15210_alpha β
  let c : ℝ := 2 * (3 : ℝ) ^ (-(5 : ℝ) / 3)
  have hβ : 1 < β := Real.one_lt_rpow (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hβ3 : β ^ 3 = 3 := by
    calc
      β ^ 3 = (3 : ℝ) ^ (((1 : ℝ) / 3) * 3) := by
        dsimp [β]
        rw [Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num), Real.rpow_ofNat]
      _ = 3 := by norm_num
  have hβ5 : β ^ 5 = (3 : ℝ) ^ ((5 : ℝ) / 3) := by
    calc
      β ^ 5 = (3 : ℝ) ^ (((1 : ℝ) / 3) * 5) := by
        dsimp [β]
        rw [Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num), Real.rpow_ofNat]
      _ = (3 : ℝ) ^ ((5 : ℝ) / 3) := by congr 1; ring
  have hpneg : (3 : ℝ) ^ (-(5 : ℝ) / 3) =
      ((3 : ℝ) ^ ((5 : ℝ) / 3))⁻¹ := by
    rw [show -(5 : ℝ) / 3 = -((5 : ℝ) / 3) by ring]
    exact Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num) _
  have hcform : c = 2 / β ^ 5 := by
    calc
      c = 2 * ((3 : ℝ) ^ ((5 : ℝ) / 3))⁻¹ := by dsimp [c]; rw [hpneg]
      _ = 2 / (3 : ℝ) ^ ((5 : ℝ) / 3) := (div_eq_mul_inv _ _).symm
      _ = 2 / β ^ 5 := by rw [hβ5]
  have hbase (s : ℕ) : c * β ^ s ≤
      (x2611_15210_A 6 (Fin s → ZMod 3) : ℝ) := by
    rw [hcform]
    exact hbaseRoot β (by linarith) hβ3 s
  have hβupper : β ≤ 3 := by
    have hp := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (x := (3 : ℝ))
      (by norm_num) (show (1 : ℝ) / 3 ≤ 1 by norm_num)
    simpa only [Real.rpow_one] using hp
  obtain ⟨ha, heq⟩ := x2611_15210_thm1_3_aux2 β hβ hβupper
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := by dsimp [c]; positivity
  have hbound := x2611_15210_thm1_3_aux4 f c a β hc ha.le (by linarith) heq
    (by
      intro r s
      calc
        c * 2 ^ r * β ^ s = 2 ^ r * (c * β ^ s) := by ring
        _ ≤ 2 ^ r * (x2611_15210_A 6 (Fin s → ZMod 3) : ℝ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbase s) (by positivity)
        _ ≤ f r s := hinit r s) hstep
  refine ⟨ha, heq, ?_⟩
  intro r hr
  have hb : c * (2 / a) ^ 4 * a ^ r ≤
      (x2611_15210_A 6 (Fin r → ZMod 6) : ℝ) := by
    simpa using (hbound r 0).trans (hfinal r)
  have hs : ((x2611_15210_A 6 (Fin r → ZMod 6) : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 ≤
      (x2611_15210_s 6 (Fin r → ZMod 6) : ℝ) := by
    have hp := x2611_15210_thm1_3_aux5 6 (Fin r → ZMod 6) (by norm_num) (by
      intro g
      ext j
      change (6 : ℕ) • g j = 0
      rw [nsmul_eq_mul, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul])
    have he : x2611_15210_A 6 (Fin r → ZMod 6) + 1 =
        x2611_15210_s 6 (Fin r → ZMod 6) := by
      unfold x2611_15210_A
      omega
    exact_mod_cast he.le
  change c * (2 / a) ^ 4 * a ^ r + 1 ≤ _
  linarith
